author: opus-5.5
body: [opus 5.5] Partly delivered in f822a788..02923363 (deployed 4a63ae8): a reply goes where the message lives (thread reply -> its thread; main-channel message -> main channel with reply_to), and a 'Start a new thread from this message' checkbox appears for main-channel roots with no replies (Google Chat). Remaining: Discord needs a server capability to create a thread from a message, and Slack cannot quote in the main channel (its reply_to always threads) — the page needs a provider capability flag for both.
